age_limit.details: The newspaper notice does not list the educational qualification or the age limit for Tax Assistant and Havaldar. It states that further details regarding educational qualifications, the proforma for submission of applications and other eligibility conditions are available on the Central Board of Indirect Taxes Departmental official website, www.cbic.gov.in, and on the Central Tax website, ccolkozone.gov.in. Candidates should check the detailed notice there before applying.

qualification.details: Applications are invited from meritorious sportspersons in the 65 disciplines mentioned in the list in Para A IV of DoPT Office Memorandum No. DOPT-1720781414772 dated 04.03.2024. As per the notice, the sportsperson should have represented one of the following. | A State or the country in the National or International competition; or medal winners in Junior National Championships; or medal winners in Khelo India Youth Games (age category above 18 years); or Khelo India Winter Games; or Khelo India Para Games; or medal winners in Khelo India University Games; or medal winners in School Games Federation of India (SGFI), in any of the games/sports mentioned above. Their University in the Inter-University Tournaments conducted by the Inter-University Sports Boards in any of the sports/games mentioned above. The State School Teams in the National Sports/Games for schools conducted by the All India School Games Federation in any of the games/sports mentioned above. | For Chess, the notice mentions the Grand Master (GM) title, International Master (IM) title or Chess Olympiad. The IM/GM title should be in the Open Category, like Woman Grandmaster (WGM) etc. While the National Open Chess Championship is treated as the National Championships, the medal-winning performance in the National Team Chess Championship will also be considered for recruitment.

salary_details.details: The pay for both posts is as per the 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC). The Tax Assistant post carries Level 4 in the pay matrix, and the Havaldar post carries Level 1. | Allowances and other benefits are not specified in the provided notification.

how_to_apply: CGST Lucknow Apply Online is not applicable for this recruitment, as the notice invites applications in the prescribed proforma by post or by hand. The proforma is available on www.cbic.gov.in and ccolkozone.gov.in.
Visit the Central Board of Indirect Taxes Departmental official website, www.cbic.gov.in, or the Central Tax website, ccolkozone.gov.in.

Get the proforma for submission of applications and fill it in.

Send the application in the prescribed proforma, either by post or by hand, to the Additional Commissioner (CCA), Office of the Principal Chief Commissioner of CGST & Central Excise Lucknow Zone, 7-A, Ashok Marg, Lucknow-226001.
Ensure the application reaches by 23.11.2026 (17:00 hrs). Applicants domiciled in North Eastern States, Andaman & Nicobar Islands, Lakshadweep, Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh get another ten (10) days.

content_sections.heading: CGST Lucknow Sports Quota Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from meritorious sportspersons in the 65 disciplines mentioned in the list in Para A IV of DoPT Office Memorandum No. DOPT-1720781414772 dated 04.03.2024. As per the notice, the sportsperson should have represented one of the following. A State or the country in the National or International competition; or medal winners in Junior National Championships; or medal winners in Khelo India Youth Games (age category above 18 years); or Khelo India Winter Games; or Khelo India Para Games; or medal winners in Khelo India University Games; or medal winners in School Games Federation of India (SGFI), in any of the games/sports mentioned above. Their University in the Inter-University Tournaments conducted by the Inter-University Sports Boards in any of the sports/games mentioned above. The State School Teams in the National Sports/Games for schools conducted by the All India School Games Federation in any of the games/sports mentioned above. For Chess, the notice mentions the Grand Master (GM) title, International Master (IM) title or Chess Olympiad. The IM/GM title should be in the Open Category, like Woman Grandmaster (WGM) etc. While the National Open Chess Championship is treated as the National Championships, the medal-winning performance in the National Team Chess Championship will also be considered for recruitment.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CGST Lucknow Sports Quota Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: CGST Lucknow Apply Online is not applicable for this recruitment, as the notice invites applications in the prescribed proforma by post or by hand. The proforma is available on www.cbic.gov.in and ccolkozone.gov.in. Visit the Central Board of Indirect Taxes Departmental official website, www.cbic.gov.in, or the Central Tax website, ccolkozone.gov.in. Read the details regarding educational qualifications and other eligibility conditions. Get the proforma for submission of applications and fill it in. Send the application in the prescribed proforma, either by post or by hand, to the Additional Commissioner (CCA), Office of the Principal Chief Commissioner of CGST & Central Excise Lucknow Zone, 7-A, Ashok Marg, Lucknow-226001. Ensure the application reaches by 23.11.2026 (17:00 hrs). Applicants domiciled in North Eastern States, Andaman & Nicobar Islands, Lakshadweep, Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh get another ten (10) days. The list of documents to be enclosed is not specified in the newspaper notice. Candidates should follow the proforma and the detailed notice.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Office of the Principal Chief Commissioner of CGST & Central Excise Zone Lucknow (CGST Lucknow) for filling various posts under the sports quota.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in CGST Lucknow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 17 vacancies available under this recruitment notification for Tax Assistant and Havaldar positions.

faq.question: Q3. What are the post names included in this recruitment?
faq.answer: The posts included in this recruitment notification are Tax Assistant and Havaldar under the sports quota.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form is 23 November 2026, which is approximately 10 days from publication.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for CGST Lucknow Recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is offline. Candidates must send their applications by post or by hand in the prescribed proforma.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Tax Assistant post?
faq.answer: The Tax Assistant post falls under Level - 4 in the pay matrix with a salary range of Rs. 25,500 to Rs. 81,100.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for the Havaldar post?
faq.answer: The Havaldar post falls under Level - 1 in the pay matrix with a salary range of Rs. 18,000 to Rs. 56,900.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises scrutiny of applications followed by field trials and verification of sports achievements.

faq.question: Q9. Where should the application be sent?
faq.answer: Applications should be sent to the Additional Commissioner (CCA), Office of the Principal Chief Commissioner of CGST & Central Excise Lucknow Zone, 7-A, Ashok Marg, Lucknow-226001.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website to download the notification and application form?
faq.answer: Candidates can visit the official Central Board of Indirect Taxes Department website at https://www.cbic.gov.in to access the notification details and application proforma.
